name: cti-threat-intel
title: CTI Threat Intelligence
description: Busca Inteligência de Ameaças (threat intel): IP, domain, hash, URL. Usa Shodan, VirusTotal, MITRE ATT&CK, PassiveTotal.

steps.action: Call MCP tool 'threatIntel' (query='192.168.1.100', provider='shodan') for IP/domain intel.
steps.expected_output: Results: 'Shodan: ports open, services, country, asn.'
steps.next: Call MCP tool 'threatIntel' (query='domain.com', provider='virustotal') for domain intel.

steps.action: Call MCP tool 'threatIntel' (query='domain.com', provider='virustotal') for domain intel.
steps.expected_output: Results: 'VT: categories (malware, p2p, gambling), score (xx/90, xx/140).'

steps.action: Report findings (threat intel report: IP/domain/hash/URL with score, categories, services).
steps.expected_output: Report: 'Target 192.168.1.100: Shodan (ports: [22,80,443], services: [ssh, http, https]), VT (score: 5/90, categories: ['malware']).'

parameters.provider: String (default: 'shodan', options: 'shodan, virustotal, passive, mitre, third-party'.
parameters.actions: String (default: 'all', options: 'all, ip, domain, hash, url, all services (services: [22,80,443]), malware, gateway (domains: malicious, gambling).'

error_handling: If 'error.code=404': report 'Threat Intel provider not found (API key missing or provider API unreachable).'
